F13_the_drafter_paraphrased_canonical_ou.what: In the B.2.3 impact-pathway table the drafter rendered every outcome as 'OCn: <compressed restatement>'. canonical_terms_preserved fails only when an id carries a title-like appositive that contradicts the canonical title; a bare id, or an id with a short role phrase, passes. The cap governs the drafter's own prose, not the transcription of a canonical identifier, so the two do not actually conflict here. The drafter appears to have applied the cap to a quotation. A prompt directive distinguishing the two is the durable fix and is not yet written.
F13_the_drafter_paraphrased_canonical_ou.open: F13 is fixed in the artifact, not in the drafter. The next section this drafter writes can repeat it.

rerun_economics.finding: Re-dispatching n08b costs no drafting quota. agent_runtime skips decomposed drafting when section_drafts/<slug>/section_spine.json carries the current run_id, and the assembler recomposes from the drafts on disk. The spine for impact carries this run id.
rerun_economics.consequence: The corrections above were made in the draft files rather than through --preseed-phase8-sections, so the real applier and assembler still run and the gate evaluates a genuinely pipeline-produced artifact.
rerun_economics.caution: Deleting section_drafts/impact/ forces a full re-draft and loses both corrections.
